note: Benton County Conservation park, 207 acres just north of Vinton on 21-acre Rodgers Lake, reached by gravel. Two camping areas: the main one on the slope above the lake's west arm, and a small loop of about six sites on the east shore by the enclosed shelter. Beach, boat ramp (electric or non-motorized), kayak launch, fishing piers, nature center and 5+ miles of trails. --Claude
summary: Rate confirmed ($20 electric; the $10 non-electric sites are primitive tent sites). Added 30/50-amp electric, pull-throughs, showers, FCFS-only booking; confirmed 57 sites (52 electric + 5 tent), dump, mid-April to end-October season. The old note's claim that water hookups and the shower house were out of service was not on any current page and is dropped. Lakeview kept for the main area (road and ~30 m of lawn between); the small east-shore loop is a lakefront lead.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (up, lakefront?): the lake is the county's '21 acre lake' (well over the 5-acre pond line). The main area's south row (~42.1974,-92.0812) sits behind the camp road with ~30 m of mown slope to the water, so lakeview there is right. But the small NE camping loop by the enclosed shelter (2025 map: about six 30/50-amp sites; NAIP centre 42.1995,-92.0788) has two or three back-ins on the east side of its loop road whose pad ends are ~13-20 m from the shoreline across open lawn, no road or day-use between (a small fishing dock sits beside them, not in front). That meets the open-apron rule for those few sites; proposing lakefront for AWH to decide, since it rests on ~2-3 of 52 sites.
